research_note: Trades as Ralart Mosaic, founded 2011, renamed Aixin Technology in Oct 2024. Range includes mosaic ARTS and mosaic MURALS alongside commodity glass and ceramic mosaic, so unlike most Foshan rows there is a custom-design side. Tier 3 geography and a supplier model pull the other way. Check whether mosaic art is a real commissioned line or a catalogue

Duratiles is the brand of Akgun Seramik: 380 million sq ft a year from five plants in Turkey and Bulgaria. Fixed-SKU volume porcelain with accessories, step treads and borders. Nothing a customer designs, so criterion 3 fails

Its own strapline is Importer and Distributer of Natural Stone. Family owned since 2007, stocks marble, limestone, travertine, onyx and granite in 100,000+ sq ft of warehouse across Miami, Atlanta and Fairfield NJ and sells through dealers. Gate 3

A leading IMPORTER and DISTRIBUTOR of ceramic and stone, supplying the largest distributors across the US and Canada from a 600,000 sq ft facility. Aeterna is its own premium sintered-slab brand, so there is brand-level design, but the business is distribution. Gate 3

The Miami sales, warehousing and logistics centre for Minera Roca Andina, a Peruvian quarry group, supplying travertine, limestone and marble from the high Andes. A distribution arm for a quarry. Gate 3 plus raw stone

Resolves to Dongguan Arts Co., Ltd, established 2002 near the Foshan ceramics base, making recycled glass mosaic, ceramics, cement products and terrazzo. No company website found, trade platforms and the Coverings listing only

Founded 1988, develops AND distributes mosaics and tiles in terrazzo, marble, glass and porcelain. Mosaic is a core S7.4 niche and 'develops' points at real in-house design, but 'distributes' and a worldwide dealer network point at gate 3. Needs the site read properly before a verdict

Registered 2014, describes itself as a supplier of premium tile, stone and mosaic that collaborates with mills in China and Malaysia. Singapore business records also class it as a tile contractor. Reseller plus contractor, gate 3 twice
Established 2001 in Morbi, 10 million sq m a year on Italian lines, ~70% exported. Volume porcelain slabs and tiles to a catalogue. Criterion 3 fails

An Italian-sounding brand operating out of Guangdong, supplying glazed and unglazed ceramic, floor, mosaic and porcelain tile. Domain came from a trade directory rather than a confirmed live site, so verify. Commodity supplier either way

The best Coverings row on the list. Founded in Israel in 2010 by three brothers, family owned, and it BOTH designs and manufactures: sculptural concrete decorative wall coverings, curated concrete tiles, and tiles with integrated lighting, from its own Petah Tikva factory and showroom. Sells into the US since 2014 and through Ann Sacks since 2017, so it is trade-facing and already US-proven. Designs in house, makes in house, flat decorative wall surface, owner-operated

Self-describes as manufacturer AND importer of natural stone: granite, marble, onyx, travertine, slate in 100+ colours, plus countertops, vanities and mosaics. Six-time MIA Pinnacle winner. Stone fabrication and import, not pattern design
Bien's large-format slab brand, running 350-metre kilns. Volume slab production. No customer design step
Established 2013, manufactures and exports porcelain floor tile from Morbi. Related entity Bluetone Impex is listed as a trader and wholesaler. Commodity catalogue
Colombian maker with 30+ years and 1.3 million sq m a month of capacity aimed at large American orders. Volume catalogue for floors, walls and bathrooms

Founded 1964, started in 2.5x2.5cm porcelain mosaic, now ~5.2 million sq m a year into 70+ countries, part of Gruppo Cerdisa Ricchetti. Mosaic is in the ICP but the business is volume catalogue production

A US wholesale distributor of marble, limestone and onyx. Worth one note: the range includes borders, MEDALLIONS and mosaics, and a medallion is a custom flat 2D design. But the company distributes rather than designs. Gate 3

A creative studio and a division of Lunada Bay Tile, Southern California. Own collections: Zel Moroccan zellige, Cotto Andaluz terracotta, Shoreline, with hand-painted and handcrafted elements. Designs original collections and makes them, which is the profile the ICP was written around. Note the competitor conflict: Lunada Bay is a tile and mosaic house, so this row takes the S7.9 walkthrough CTA with no link to MEC's tool

Too generic to resolve. Searches collide with Eco Ceramica (ecoceramica.com), an unrelated 27-year Italian wall and floor tile maker. Do not use that domain for this row. Needs the Coverings exhibitor listing
Conterno family, 60 years, selects and processes marble, quartzite, granite, onyx and semi-precious stone slabs in the Vicenza marble district. Slab processing, no pattern design

Founded by Franki Lee, supplies glass, marble, pool, recycled glass and porcelain mosaic plus waterjet and decor tile. Exports mainly to the US, Canada and Ecuador. The operating site appears to be dozanmosaic.com rather than anything matching the registered name, so verify. Commodity mosaic supplier

company: Foshan Hengsheng New Material Co., Ltd.
research_note: Glass mosaic specialist since 2008, 2,000+ models with new items monthly, into hotels, pools and bathrooms. High SKU churn, no customer design step

Founded 1992 with Ecuadorian capital, first technical porcelain producer in Ecuador and on the Pacific coast, now digital printing and large format. Producer and national distributor. Volume catalogue
A distributor with 40+ limestone options in stock, offering custom solutions across North America. Limestone distribution. Gate 3 plus raw stone

Founded 2005, dedicated solely to R&D and production of mosaic tile, export focused into North and South America, Europe and Australia. Real mosaic manufacturer but a high-end catalogue supplier, not a design-to-approval business

A Taiwanese tile supplier visible only in import records, shipping to The Tile Shop in Plymouth MN. Do NOT use honortile.com: that is Zibo Honor Ceramic, an unrelated Chinese maker. Needs the Coverings listing

Brand created in 2006 to supply ceramic tile and deco accessories to architects, builders and importers of building materials worldwide. Domain came from a summary rather than a confirmed live page. Supplier to importers, gate 3
IKAD and MUZZI are two brands of an Indonesian porcelain manufacturer, designs developed by Italian and Chinese teams, in standard sizes from 12x24 to 32x32. Volume catalogue
Founded 1994, produces glass, ceramic and porcelain tile on high-technology lines. Coverings lists it under decorative, glass, mosaic and porcelain tile. Volume producer
No match after searching. Results collide with Inno Stickers (peel-and-stick), Innovation Stone & Tile and Stone Innovations, all unrelated. Needs the Coverings exhibitor listing
Trades as Tesoro. Supplies porcelain, ceramic and natural stone to retail floorcovering stores, design centres and specialty tile shops nationwide. The name states the business model. Gate 3

Genuinely interesting and genuinely unreachable. A mosaic tile company in Southern California started by two friends from art school who wanted to make their own designer tiles, with an office and showroom at 272 Gemini Ave, Brea CA. That is an ICP profile. But it has no website: it sells through Amazon, Wayfair, Perigold, AllModern and Faire. Do NOT use intrend.co.in, an unrelated Indian wall-tile company. Needs a manual look or a phone call
Founded 2009 by Kiran Patel, promotes Italian-styled design into Indian homes, 200+ employees, large-format wall and floor tile and slabs. Volume catalogue
Formed 2004, one of India's leading suppliers and distributors of large-format wall and floor tile, exporting to 85+ countries. Supplier and distributor at volume

Could not be resolved. Searches return unrelated Italian mosaic businesses: Fantini Mosaici, Orsoni Smalti, the Ravenna Mosaic Art School, Italian Mosaic Masters. Worth a second look from the Coverings listing, because an Italian mosaic house would be on-niche if it designs

Started in 1991 by Jim and Janice Lawson as a HAND-PAINTED tile business and still describes itself as producing high-end decorative mosaic tile, 30+ years on, distributing nationally from Norco CA. Founder-led, decorative, mosaic. Competitor conflict with MEC, so walkthrough CTA, no tool link

A producer and manufacturer of natural stone mosaic tile, premium marble mosaics for backsplashes, shower floors and walls. Makes its own mosaics in Connecticut. On-niche and on-medium. Competitor conflict with MEC, so walkthrough CTA

company: Keen Ocean Asia Ltd/NOVA Breeze SDN.BHD.
research_note: Established 2002, manufactures glass, stone and metal mosaic and has exported to North America for 21+ years. No company website surfaced, only the Coverings listing. Commodity mosaic manufacturer

Two things share this name in Cuenca and they matter differently. keramikos.com.ec is Keramikos S.A., the retail and distribution arm and Porcelanosa's Ecuador distributor, with boutiques in Cuenca, Guayaquil and Quito. The Coverings exhibitor is the producer group behind Ceramicas Rialto, Ecuaceramica and Italpisos. Either way it is distribution or volume production. Verify which entity the listing means

Runs a 300,000 sq ft Houston showroom and warehouse plus 673,000 sq ft in Florida and 130,000 in Atlanta, selling porcelain, pavers, travertine, marble and pool coping. Warehouse and showroom distribution. Gate 3

Incorporated Dec 2016 in Morbi, makes glazed porcelain tile and granite slab, also trades as LV Granito. Its own company registration records list the website as Not Available, so this is a confirmed no-site row, not a failed search. Commodity producer

Industrias Ceramicas Lourdes, wholly Argentine, 25 years, the first Argentine and second Latin American company to run a digital production line. SPL is its San Pietro Laminas product. Digital printing at volume, still a catalogue

Two brands, both Dal-Tile and therefore Mohawk: Marazzi since 1935, American Olean since 1923. Genuine design operations but a 200+ enterprise, which per the S7.4 decision-maker table means a Head of Design or digital lead and a long cycle. Tag separately and deprioritise rather than drop

Four unrelated companies use this name, in the Dominican Republic (marmotech.com.do), Turkey (marmotech.com.tr), Saudi Arabia (marmotech.co) and Egypt with US operations (marmotech-us.com). Cannot be pinned without the Coverings listing. All of them extract, cut, polish or distribute marble, so the row fails gate 3 whichever it is

Founded 1931 by Manzo Kato, incorporated 1957, in Tajimi, the centre of Japanese tile production. 65+ years making porcelain MOSAIC tile, 100% made in Japan, local mineral clays, natural glazes, 24-hour firing, with Majolica and Deco named lines. A real artisan mosaic maker with named collections. Competitor conflict with MEC, so walkthrough CTA

Stands out from the other Foshan rows: it describes itself as DESIGNING and producing mosaics and tiles for clients, with commercial offices in Spain, Mexico, Australia and Brazil alongside the Foshan HQ and showroom. Range spans metal, porcelain, natural stone, engineered stone and craft glass. 'For clients' suggests project and custom work. Worth a site read

No company of this exact name found. Nearby names are all different companies: MMG Tile & Stone (mmgmarble.com), MG Stone Surface (mgstone-surface.com), Marble & Granite Designs UK (mgduk.com). Do not assume any of them. Needs the Coverings listing
25 years producing travertine from Denizli, selling to chains and wholesalers in 30+ countries. Travertine production plus wholesale. Raw stone, gate 3

Part of NG Group, interior and exterior ceramic across many models and sizes, sold to architects, builders and designers. Domain from a summary rather than a confirmed page, so verify. Volume catalogue

Registered in Singapore in Sept 2019, principal activity recorded as wholesale of structural clay and concrete products, operating out of Foshan. Designs and produces porcelain stoneware for commercial, public and residential space but has no findable website, only an Instagram. Wholesale, gate 3
Founded 1978 by Oswaldo Martins, merged with Grespor and Cerev in 2004. Portuguese volume wall and floor tile. Catalogue production

Established 1989, India's largest full-body porcelain maker, brands PAVITS and VICTORY, present in 40 countries. Already runs a tile visualizer, so it belongs in the has-a-configurator note, but the product is a fixed catalogue so criterion 3 still fails
Founded 2002, US arm since 2014, a distributor of floor and wall tile imported from Europe and Asia, sold through 500+ authorised stores in Florida. Gate 3
Since 2010, a benchmark in marble-effect ceramic surfaces on Italian technology, five finishes, standard colour families. Volume catalogue

company: Qingdao Century Import & Export Co., Ltd
research_note: Established 2005, exports slabs, tile, mosaic, countertops, vanity tops, sinks and landscape stone, working with dozens of partner factories in Xiamen plus two of its own in Shandong. The name is the business model. Gate 3

QUA Granite started production in 2016 and now runs Turkey's largest technical-granite-only plant at 41 million sq m a year with 1,000+ employees, exporting to 100+ countries. Pure volume. Criterion 3 fails

Roca Tile's tile division was bought by Grupo Lamosa in Sept 2021 and the two run together as ROCA TILE USA and LAMOSA USA, with design studios and showrooms in Miami, Chicago and New York. 100+ years of manufacturing and distribution. Same call as Marazzi: real design operation, enterprise buyer, long cycle, deprioritise rather than drop

Saxolia is the house brand Italcrafts launched into North America in 2021. Italcrafts itself, since 1976, is a TRADING company in tiles and furnishing accessories and the market leader in Africa and the Caribbean. A trader with a private label. Gate 3
Established Nov 2002 in Shunde, Foshan, manufactures crystal mosaic at 450,000 sq m a year. No own website: Alibaba, Made-in-China and the Coverings listing only. Commodity manufacturer
One of China's leading white marble suppliers and exporters, four production bases in Shanghai, Sichuan, Fujian and Jiangsu Yixing. Domain from a summary, verify. Raw stone export
40+ years as a wholesale distributor of natural stone, specialising in honed, antiqued and distressed material. Wholesale distribution. Gate 3
Stoneglass is a crystallised glass-stone MATERIAL made in Tuscany, specified by architects for cladding, ventilated facades, flooring and marine use. A material brand, not a pattern designer

Describes itself as the largest stocking dealer of ceramic and porcelain tile, laminate and hardwood in the South, trading as Stover's Liquidation. A stocking dealer clearing inventory. Gate 3, and the liquidation model means no design step at all

The most arguable row on the list. An importer, DESIGNER and distributor that owns Lungarno Ceramics (2013, designer-led collections including handmade wall tile) and CommodiTile (2017), and says it is involved in all phases of the tile design process while sourcing production from Asia and Europe. So it designs but does not manufacture. Under the 24 Aug S7.4 pivot 'makes the product themselves' is no longer a hard gate, which means this row now qualifies on criteria 1 and 3 where it would have been dropped before the pivot. A clean test of whether the pivot was right

company: TAB Surfaces - Natural Stone and QUARTZ
research_note: One of the largest natural stone and quartz processors in the world: granite, marble, slate, quartzite, sandstone, limestone plus the TABQUARTZ engineered line. Slab processing. No pattern

Founded 2002 and states plainly that it is a DIRECT IMPORTER of natural stone tile, mosaic, tumbled stone, moulding, slabs and trim, bringing containers from Turkey, Italy and China into Tampa inventory. Gate 3

Tendenzza Pisos y Recubrimientos SA de CV, a Mexican porcelain tile brand sold through Azulemex, Surtidor and Construrama, with collections like Carrara, Nero, Imperia and Novara. No own corporate site found. Volume catalogue
Founded 1995, reached 24 million sq m a year after 2018 investment, producing standard-size porcelain floor, wall and parquet tile. Pure volume

Self-describes as manufacturer, importer AND US distributor of ceramic, stone and glass mosaic. All three roles in one sentence, so the maker share is unknown. Mosaic is on-niche and the company is small enough for the owner to be the buyer. Worth a site read rather than a drop

A Pennsylvania-registered entity selling tile made in Morbi into North America, and the one commodity-adjacent row with a real design hook: it runs dedicated CUSTOM TILES and MOSAIC pages offering customisation of size, shape, colour and finish. That is criterion 1 and 3 on paper. The catch is that its stated customer is the North American IMPORTER, not an end customer, so confirm who actually makes the design choice

A platform rather than a maker: it aggregates premium Japanese tile and supports designers with free samples and BIM data. TN Corporation manufactures porcelain in the same Gifu region and may be the operator. A specifier-facing marketplace could be a channel partner rather than a prospect. Only regional sites surfaced, so verify the primary domain

Founded 1907-08, part of Gruppo Dei which the Dei family has owned since 1960, extracting and processing travertine in Rapolano Terme. Two domains appear for it, so confirm which is current. Quarrying and processing, no pattern

Specialises in marble, glass, ceramic and metal mosaic and sells under the brand Chroma Mosaico. No own website surfaced, only a trade directory. Note the name collides with TREND Group (trend-group.com), a well-known and unrelated Italian mosaic house. Commodity mosaic supplier

Not a prospect: Turkishceramics is the state-backed export promotion group for Turkish ceramic manufacturers, set up in 1997, representing 30+ member companies. There is nobody here to buy a tool. It is a SOURCING lead though, since its member directory is a free, pre-filtered list of Turkish tile makers

20+ years in Morbi, manufactures and exports ceramic wall and floor tile, polished glazed vitrified, parking tile, slabs and sanitaryware. Sanitaryware is an explicit exclusion and the rest is commodity catalogue
A leading player in Bangladesh's ceramic market selling premium Italian tile under the X Monica, X Monalisa and X Alexander brands, plus bathware. A brand portfolio over imported product. Gate 3

Built by Portia Guo in 2013-14 and describes itself as a SPECIALTY MANUFACTURER of high-end natural stone mosaic, field tile and countertops, booked at Verona and Coverings. A small, founder-run mosaic maker rather than a trading house, which separates it from the other Xiamen rows. Tier 3 geography and stone rather than printed pattern are the arguments against

company: XIAMEN STONELINK IMP. & EXP. CO. , LTD
research_note: 12+ years as a stone project supplier offering a one-stop stone solution, 252 shipments to 33 buyers mainly in Indonesia, the US and Vietnam. No independent website: Alibaba and Facebook only. Import and export, gate 3

Born from uniting Italian design culture with Japanese ceramic craftsmanship, and every tile is designed by hand by Japanese artisans. Note the geography: despite sitting in a Coverings row next to Turkish brands, this is Japanese and Italian, not Turkish. Hand-designed artisan tile with named collections. Competitor conflict with MEC on the tile side

Founded 1993 and one of the pioneers that brought MOSAIC ART into home decoration, now a significant force in global mosaic, doing stone mosaic, art mosaic and lava. Art mosaic means commissioned custom work, which is the approval-wait the tool removes. Tier 3 geography and a direct MEC competitor, so walkthrough CTA
